name: How long does a typical kitchen cabinet replacement project take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen cabinet replacement project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical kitchen cabinet replacement project can range from two to six weeks, depending on the scope and whether custom or pre-fabricated cabinets are chosen. This timeframe includes design, material ordering, demolition, and installation. Custom cabinets, often favored in the unique homes of Berkeley and Albany, require longer lead times for fabrication. We provide a detailed project schedule, outlining each phase from initial design to final walkthrough, allowing you to plan accordingly.
